full_name: Harry Mairson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Engineering & Computer Science Rieman and Baketel Fellow for Music Brandeis University
bio: Harry Mairson is a professor of computer science at Brandeis University and cello maker who is interested in designing and using software to inform the artisanal practice of making classical stringed instruments.
